note: Planning worksheet, not pilot CLI input. Replace every placeholder from repository discovery. Each card's boundary sentence is only a starting worker_boundary: the coordinator must author the full scope-specific boundary contract below and receive granted authorization before preparing a packet. These are twelve real-trial candidates, not completed runs or model-quality evidence.

boundary_contract.category_rule: Each category contains nonempty explicit items or a nonempty not_applicable explanation, never both.
boundary_contract.preparation_check: Inspect worker-contract.md exact JSON and SHA-256 before routing.

cards.goal: Independently review one reconciled component's behavior against both source versions.
Review one persistence or migration seam for retained behavior and data-safety issues.
cards.boundary: One seam; no deployment or data migration.

cards.goal: Review one public interface reconciliation against the agreed compatibility contract.
cards.boundary: One API boundary; coordinator owns product decisions.

cards.goal: Review one user flow for behavior retained from both source versions.
cards.boundary: One flow; report missing product requirements.

cards.goal: Add a regression test for one agreed component behavior.
Add bounded regression coverage for one persistence compatibility case.
cards.boundary: No schema redesign or production migration.

cards.goal: Add a contract test for one retained public interface behavior.
cards.boundary: One interface and existing test harness.

cards.goal: Add a regression test for one reconciled user-flow edge case.
Fix one confirmed localized component defect found during consolidation.
cards.boundary: One component; isolated checkout; coordinator integrates.

cards.goal: Fix one confirmed bounded persistence compatibility defect.
cards.boundary: No destructive data action or release.

cards.goal: Fix one confirmed public interface regression.
Fix one confirmed reconciled user-flow defect.
